# Version 4.151.0
> **Skia m151 and performance** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates to Skia m151 and removes overhead from frequently used color and text paths. It also adds .NET 11 WebAssembly support through Emscripten 5.0.6, fixes CPU raster output, and closes an image-decoding resource leak.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m151** — Moves the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 151 and includes four subsequent rounds of upstream correctness and stability fixes. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489))

## API Surface

- **Color parsing gains span-based overloads** — New ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads let callers parse SKColor hex values without first allocating a string, while the existing paths are faster. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))
- **Text and color hot paths allocate less** — HarfBuzz UTF-8 encoding and tag parsing avoid per-call allocations, SKShaper reads glyph results through zero-copy spans, and common color conversions no longer require native round trips. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385), [#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396), [#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408))
- **GRContextOptions no longer requires unsafe code** — Removing the unnecessary unsafe modifier allows projects to use this type without enabling unsafe compilation. ([#3991](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3991))

## Bug Fixes

- **CPU raster output restored** — Restoring the legacy shader context fixes a CPU image-sampling regression introduced with the m151 engine update. ([#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428))
- **Cropped image decoding no longer leaks** — SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) now releases its native resource when the requested crop cannot produce an image. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))
- **WebAssembly macro conflict removed** — The Skia build no longer redundantly defines SK_BUILD_FOR_WASM, avoiding toolchain warnings and build failures. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3788](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3788))

## Platform

- **.NET 11 WebAssembly support** — Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries support .NET 11 WebAssembly and its exnref exception-handling model. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487), [#4488](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4488))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 makes UTF-8 text ingestion and tag parsing allocation-free.
